instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.criterion: Use only NOAA station 9414290 and its details.self URL (or clearly report access failure)
criteria.description: Agent must restrict data collection to station 9414290 base endpoint and then follow the exact URL found in that station's details.self field for the second lookup. Full credit if the agent uses/attempts only these endpoints and, if either endpoint is inaccessible (down/blocked/rate-limited) or the details.self link is missing from the response, it clearly reports the issue and stops without fabricating values. Partial credit if station 9414290 is used but the second lookup is attempted from a different URL than details.self due to an explicit, documented failure to retrieve details.self. No credit if a different station is used or additional unrelated sources are mixed in when the NOAA endpoints are available.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows the base station JSON for id "9414290" and includes details.self = "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json". Screenshot 2 (latest) shows the details JSON for id "9414290" and self matches that same details URL. Action History also shows a visit to the same details.json URL. No evidence indicates use of other stations or endpoints.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Evidence supports that the agent stayed within station 9414290 and used the correct details.self URL for the second lookup. No adjustment needed.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows a browser-like JSON pretty-print view with a checkbox label “Pretty-print”. The visible JSON object includes fields: "id": "9414290", "established": "1854-06-29 00:00:02", "removed": "", "noaachart": "18649", "timemeridian": -120, "timezone": -8.0, "origyear": "1988-09-01 00:00:00", and "self": "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json".
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot confirms the agent is viewing data for station id 9414290 and shows the exact details.self URL for that station (ending in /stations/9414290/details.json). However, the screenshot does not show the base station endpoint (/stations/9414290.json) or any evidence that only those two endpoints were used—only the details JSON is visible. Based on visible pixels alone, it supports use of station 9414290 and its details.self URL, but cannot fully verify endpoint restriction beyond that.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No contradiction: the agent’s action history indicates visiting the details URL that is visible in the screenshot. The screenshot does not show any base-station fields (name/state/lat/long/timezone abbreviation/correction), so the agent’s claimed base-station retrieval is not verifiable from this image.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows a JSON response viewer with a “Pretty-print” checkbox at the top and a JSON object containing "stations": [ { ... } ]. Within the visible station object, it shows "id": "9414290" and a "details" object with "self": "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json". Other related links (e.g., sensors.self, datums.self, etc.) are also visible, all using the 9414290 path. No content from the details.json response itself is visible in this screenshot.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot supports that the agent is using station 9414290 and that the exact details.self URL is https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json. However, the screenshot does not show the second lookup being performed or the details.json fields/results; it only shows the base station JSON containing the link. So the restriction to station 9414290 and the correct details.self URL is confirmed, but completion of the follow-up retrieval is not visually evidenced here.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent’s Action History claims visiting the details.json URL and Predicted Output reports fields from that details endpoint, but this screenshot only shows the base station JSON (including the details.self link), not the details.json response content. No evidence in the screenshot confirms the details fields were actually retrieved.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: Action History shows a visit to https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json (Action 1). DOM-model state 1 (latest) shows the browser at that same URL and JSON includes "id": "9414290" and "self": "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json". DOM-model state 0 (earlier) indicates the base endpoint https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290.json and includes a details.self pointing to the same details URL.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Evidence supports that only station 9414290 endpoints were used and that the details URL used matches the station’s details.self. Even though the DOM alone can’t prove the details URL was extracted (vs typed), the combination of base DOM evidence (state 0) and the visited details page (state 1) supports compliance with the constraint to use station 9414290 and the details.self URL.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 shows the base endpoint URL `https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290.json` and within the JSON includes `"id": "9414290"` and `"details": { "self": "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json" }`.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
The DOM-model evidence supports that the base station endpoint is for station 9414290 and provides the exact `details.self` URL that should be used for the second lookup. However, there is no DOM-model snapshot showing the follow-up navigation to the `details.self` URL, so it cannot be fully verified from DOM evidence alone that the second lookup was restricted to (and used) only that URL, or that it succeeded.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Missing DOM-model state for the `https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json` visit; therefore the endpoint-restriction compliance for the second lookup cannot be fully confirmed via DOM evidence.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 shows the browser at URL "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json" and the visible JSON includes "id": "9414290" and "self": "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json".
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
The DOM evidence confirms access was restricted to station 9414290 on the details endpoint (URL contains /stations/9414290/details.json and JSON has "id": "9414290"). However, the DOM-model provided includes only the details endpoint state and does not include any DOM evidence that the base station endpoint (e.g., /stations/9414290.json) was accessed, nor that the visited details URL was obtained specifically from the base response’s details.self field rather than directly used. Therefore, strict compliance with “use only station 9414290 base endpoint and then follow the exact URL found in that station's details.self field” cannot be fully verified from DOM state 1 alone.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Missing DOM evidence of base-station endpoint retrieval (/stations/9414290.json) and missing DOM evidence that details.self was extracted from that base response before visiting the details URL.

criteria.criterion: Report base-station fields (ID, name, state, lat/long, timezone abbreviation & correction)
criteria.description: From the station 9414290 base response, report: station ID, name, state, latitude, longitude, timezone abbreviation, and timezone correction. Full credit if all fields are present and match values exactly as returned. If the NOAA base response is inaccessible or does not contain one or more of these fields, full credit is still possible if the agent explicitly states which fields could not be retrieved and does not guess. Partial credit if 1–2 fields are missing/altered despite being present in the response, or if minor transcription/rounding errors occur. No credit if values are for a different station or are fabricated.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 1 (base station JSON) visibly contains id "9414290", name "San Francisco", state "CA", lat 37.806305, timezone "PST", and timezoncor -8. Longitude is not visible in the screenshot, and the agent’s predicted output explicitly omits longitude.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: The agent output is missing a required base-station field (longitude). Other required base fields are supported by the screenshot and match. This is a substantive omission (not just a nitpick), so the score should remain reduced.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: In the visible base station JSON, the station object includes: "state": "CA", "timezone": "PST", "timezoncor": -8, "id": "9414290", "name": "San Francisco", and "lat": 37.806305. The "lng"/longitude field is not visible in the screenshot portion shown (it may be below the fold).
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot confirms several required base-station fields exactly: ID 9414290, name San Francisco, state CA, latitude 37.806305, timezone abbreviation PST, and timezone correction (timezoncor) -8. Longitude is not visible in the screenshot, so the agent’s predicted output value for longitude cannot be verified from this image; moreover, the agent’s predicted output explicitly notes longitude was “not reloaded this step,” indicating incompleteness versus the requirement to report longitude from the base response.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The screenshot shows latitude 37.806305, timezone PST, and timezoncor -8 matching the agent’s claims. But the agent did not provide a longitude value, and longitude is not visible in the screenshot, so the predicted output is incomplete relative to the stated task/criterion. Also, the agent’s statement that latitude was “as previously observed” is unnecessary given the latitude is visible here.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 0 shows base-station fields: "id": "9414290", "name": "San Francisco", "state": "CA", "lat": 37.806305, "timezone": "PST", "timezonecorr": -8. Longitude is not visible in the provided base DOM snapshot. Agent predicted output omits the longitude value entirely (it states it was not reloaded).
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The agent correctly reported ID, name, state, latitude, timezone abbreviation, and timezone correction as supported by DOM state 0. However, longitude was required and was not provided as a value in the final output; therefore full credit is not warranted.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 visible JSON includes `"id": "9414290"`, `"name": "San Francisco"`, `"state": "CA"`, `"timezone": "PST"`, `"timezonecorr": -8`, and `"lat": 37.806305,` (longitude is not visible in the provided snapshot).
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
The DOM evidence directly supports several required base-station fields (ID, name, state, latitude, timezone abbreviation, timezone correction). The required longitude value is not present in the provided DOM snapshot, so the agent’s claimed longitude cannot be verified (and was also not explicitly provided in the agent’s predicted output for this step).
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Longitude is required by the rubric but is not present in the captured DOM evidence (and not actually reported as a value in the agent predicted output—only mentioned as not reloaded).

criteria.criterion: Follow details.self and report required linked-details fields
criteria.description: Using the exact details.self URL from station 9414290 (as obtained from the base response), report: established, origyear, removed (preserve empty exactly if returned), noaachart, timemeridian, and timezone. Full credit if all requested fields are captured exactly as returned. If the details.self endpoint is inaccessible or the fields are missing from the response, full credit is still possible if the agent clearly reports the retrieval failure/missing fields and does not substitute from other endpoints (e.g., product availability) or invent values. Partial credit if 1–2 fields are missing or formatting is altered when the correct values are available in the response. No credit if details are sourced from a non-details.self endpoint without a documented access failure, or if values are substituted/guessed.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 2 (details JSON; latest for linked-details) clearly shows: established "1854-06-29 00:00:02", origyear "1988-09-01 00:00:00", removed "" (empty string), noaachart "18649", timemeridian -120, timezone -8.0, and self URL matching the required details endpoint.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: All requested linked-details fields are present in the screenshot and are transcribed in the agent’s predicted output with matching formatting (timestamps, signs/decimals, and the empty removed value). No adjustment needed.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The JSON visible in the screenshot contains the required linked-details fields exactly as text: "established": "1854-06-29 00:00:02", "origyear": "1988-09-01 00:00:00", "removed": "", "noaachart": "18649", "timemeridian": -120, and "timezone": -8.0. It also shows "self": "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json".
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot supports that the agent followed the details.self URL and that all requested linked-details fields are present and can be reported exactly. The agent’s predicted output values for these fields match what is visible, including the empty removed value and the signs/decimals for timemeridian/timezone.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No discrepancies for the linked-details fields: the agent’s listed established/origyear/removed/noaachart/timemeridian/timezone match the screenshot text.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 1 (latest) shows the details JSON from https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json with: "established": "1854-06-29 00:00:02", "origyear": "1988-09-01 00:00:00", "removed": "" (empty string), "noaachart": "18649", "timemeridian": -120, "timezone": -8.0. Agent predicted output lists the same values.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: All requested linked-details fields are explicitly present in the latest DOM and match the agent’s reported values and formatting (including empty removed, signs, and decimal in timezone).

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 only contains the base station JSON and the link `"details": { "self": "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json" }`. No DOM-model content for the details endpoint response is provided.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: UNKNOWN
The DOM-model evidence does not include the response from the `details.self` URL, so it cannot support or refute the reported linked-details fields (established, origyear, removed, noaachart, timemeridian, timezone). Action history indicates a visit occurred, but per the rubric, actions do not prove the browser-returned content.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: All linked-details values (established, origyear, removed, noaachart, timemeridian, timezone) are unverified due to missing DOM snapshot of the details endpoint response.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 visible content is the JSON object: { "id": "9414290", "established": "1854-06-29 00:00:02", "removed": "", "noaachart": "18649", "timemeridian": -120, "timezone": -8.0, "origyear": "1988-09-01 00:00:00", "self": "https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/mdapi/prod/webapi/stations/9414290/details.json" }.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: SUPPORTED
The DOM evidence directly contains all required linked-details fields from the details.self endpoint for station 9414290: established, origyear, removed (empty string), noaachart, timemeridian, and timezone. The accessed URL matches the "self" field shown in the response, and no substitutions from other endpoints are evidenced or needed for these fields.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: None for the linked-details fields; all requested fields are present in the details JSON and can be recorded exactly as shown.

criteria.criterion: Respect task constraints on exactness and stopping condition
criteria.description: Agent must: (a) preserve numbers, signs, timestamps, and the empty removed value exactly as returned; (b) not substitute product availability dates for station-detail dates; (c) not infer/explain why established and origyear differ; and (d) stop after all requested base-station and linked-details fields are recorded (or after clearly reporting inability to retrieve them). Full credit if constraints are met or if the agent stops and reports access/data limitations without adding unsupported content. Partial credit if minor extra commentary is included but does not add unsupported inferences or contradict data. No credit if the agent alters required exact values, introduces substituted dates, adds inference about established vs origyear, or continues beyond the requested fields with speculative/irrelevant content.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshot 2 confirms exact linked-detail formatting (timestamps, removed empty string, timemeridian -120, timezone -8.0). No screenshot contradicts the agent’s adherence to constraints; the predicted output does not add inferences about established vs origyear and stops after reporting requested fields.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: For the fields the agent did report, it preserved exact values and did not introduce forbidden substitutions or inferences. The only notable issue is the missing longitude, which is already accounted for under Criterion 1 rather than a separate constraints violation here. No adjustment needed.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows exact numeric and timestamp formatting for linked-details: established "1854-06-29 00:00:02"; origyear "1988-09-01 00:00:00"; removed "" (empty string); noaachart "18649"; timemeridian -120; timezone -8.0.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: For the linked-details portion, the agent preserves numbers/signs/timestamps and the empty removed value exactly as shown, and does not add explanations about why established and origyear differ. However, the agent’s predicted output includes base-station fields (name/state/latitude/longitude/timezone abbreviation/correction) that are not visible in this screenshot, and even notes longitude was “not reloaded this step,” which introduces risk of unverifiable/possibly incorrect base-station data relative to the task’s exactness requirement (though not contradicted by the screenshot). The stopping condition appears respected (the agent stops after listing requested fields).
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The screenshot cannot corroborate the agent’s base-station values (name, state, latitude, longitude, timezone abbreviation/correction). The linked-details values are consistent with the screenshot; no extra inference about established vs origyear is present.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM-model state 1 confirms exact linked-details formatting (timestamps, empty removed string, signed values). DOM-model state 0 confirms exactness for the subset of base fields visible there (id/name/state/lat/timezone/timezonecorr). Agent output did not provide longitude at all.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: The agent preserved linked-details values exactly as shown and did not add inferences about established vs origyear, satisfying those constraints. However, the stopping condition is framed as stopping after *all* requested base-station and linked-details fields are recorded; because longitude was not recorded, the task was not fully completed as required. Proportional deduction.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 provides base-station values (ID/name/state/lat/timezone/timezonecorr) but does not provide longitude, and provides no details-endpoint content to check exact timestamps/signs/empty removed preservation. The agent predicted output includes an empty `removed:` field and specific timestamps/signs, but these are not present in DOM evidence.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
From DOM evidence, the agent can be checked for exactness only on the subset of base fields shown (ID/name/state/lat/timezone/timezonecorr), which appear to match what is visible. Constraints concerning exact linked-details values (timestamps, signs, and empty `removed`) and the stopping condition cannot be fully verified because the linked-details DOM response is not available, and longitude is also missing from the DOM snapshot.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Cannot verify exact preservation of linked-details values (including empty `removed`) due to missing details DOM; cannot verify longitude exactness because it is absent from the base DOM snapshot.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 shows exact values and formats for linked-details fields, including timestamps and numeric signs: "established": "1854-06-29 00:00:02", "origyear": "1988-09-01 00:00:00", "removed": "" (empty), "noaachart": "18649", "timemeridian": -120, "timezone": -8.0.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
The DOM evidence supports exactness and formatting preservation for the linked-details fields (numbers, signs, timestamps, and empty removed value are explicitly present). However, the rubric criterion also covers base-station fields (station ID, name, state, latitude, longitude, timezone abbreviation, timezone correction) and the stopping condition relative to “after all requested base-station and linked-details fields have been recorded.” Since the provided DOM evidence contains only the details endpoint and not the base-station response, compliance for preserving the base-station values exactly as returned (and whether any extra, unsupported commentary was added beyond requested fields) cannot be fully verified from DOM state 1 alone.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: No DOM support for base-station fields (name/state/lat/long/timezone abbreviation/timezone correction) being retrieved and preserved exactly; only linked-details exactness is verifiable from the provided DOM state.
